title: Sable and the Letters
author: Ada Joubert
blurb: Isandro Halloran, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
